first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, making a targeted onboarding simplification the most direct response while preserving long-term revenue quality better than broad discounting. Verify the prior onboarding result before acting, and run a guarded test to ensure shorter onboarding does not reduce lead qualification or downstream retention.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, directly addressing the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified prior result showed 13% higher completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and 3% higher 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than relying on discounts. Monitor activation, qualified-account rate, time-to-value, and 30-day retention to detect downstream value risk.
